additionalDocuments.label: The Portman original brochure and amenity plans (Mitchell’s mirror)

review.gallery: The developer’s October 2026 progress photograph leads the gallery and listing card. Nine developer web renders show the building entry, shared spaces and apartment interiors.
review.location: The brochure marks the building on the eastern side of JVC. Property Finder identifies District 12, and Dubainary corroborates the approximate Mitchell’s point. The English slim brochure and full brochure give the same eleven travel estimates.
review.floorPlans: Sixteen complete drawings include eleven residence types, ground-floor retail, two residential floor plates and two amenity drawings. Totals follow the original printed labels. Several component sums differ from the printed total by 0.01 sq ft.

unavailable: Surveyed visitor entrance, verified completed photography and plans for individual contracted units.
